evidence.quote: [/page/6/Text/2] The participants were administered a multisection questionnaire measuring the goals, appraisals and indicators of well- and ill-being at five different waves across two competitive seasons. Each participant completed the questionnaire along with their respective team in a classroom setting before training at the beginning of season one (wave 1), near the end of season one (wave 2), and at the beginning (wave 3), middle (wave 4) and end of season two (wave 5).
